title: asperula cynanchica var. alpina
intro: Asperula cynanchica var. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues like coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Woodruff include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
